title: fix: bill MiniMax H3 Max Turbo at fal list rates
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: H3 Max Turbo still billed the launch promo rates (\$0.00625/\$0.01/\$0.02 per s); the 2026-09-15 restore never happened
- Sets fal list rates: \$0.025 / \$0.04 / \$0.08 per output second (480p/768p/1080p), verified on fal.ai 2026-09-25
- fal promo (half list) runs until Sep 30, so we overcharge ~2x until then, then match list
- Replaces the price part of #14431 (stacked on #14747); credit @ElliotEtag

Co-authored-by: ElliotEtag <$(gh api users/ElliotEtag -q .id)+ElliotEtag@users.noreply.github.com>

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Turbo gets its price tag
gist.blurb: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo’s billing labels have been replanted at fal’s standard list rates. Each output resolution now has a clear, matching per-second price.
gist.summary: Fixed MiniMax H3 Max Turbo billing to use fal list rates of $0.025/s at 480p, $0.04/s at 768p, and $0.08/s at 1080p instead of the lingering launch-promo rates.
gist.impact: Developers using H3 Max Turbo now receive billing that consistently matches fal’s documented per-output-second list rates across all three resolutions.
